page.content:
2023 reboot with Fire God Liu Kang keeping the new era.

How Mortal Kombat 1 connects

  • Character: Liu Kang — Mortal Kombat 1 casts Fire God Liu Kang as keeper of the new era.
  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Mortal Kombat 1 is the 2023 timeline reboot.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 11 — Mortal Kombat 11 closed a timeline that Mortal Kombat 1 then rebooted.
  • Character: Shang Tsung — Mortal Kombat 1 immediately sets Shang Tsung against Liu Kang's new history.

What is Mortal Kombat 1?

Mortal Kombat 1 is the timeline reboot in which Liu Kang, now a Fire God, rebuilds history — and Shang Tsung immediately starts unpicking it.

Key threads lead to Liu Kang, Mortal Kombat, Mortal Kombat 11 and Shang Tsung.
